description:
DOS Browser is a specialized, lightweight browser designed with retro computing enthusiasts in mind.
It features hardware acceleration specifically optimized for DOS/Win9x-based games, allowing them to run more
efficiently and at much higher speeds compared to standard browsers like Chrome.
Whether you’re exploring DOS applications, playing classic games, or navigating retro-themed websites,
DOS Browser ensures a smoother and more enjoyable experience.

Install DOS Browser from Flathub today and rediscover the golden era of computing
with cutting-edge enhancements for your classic favorites!
